name: Small Beer
desc: Warm, flat, and load-bearing. Restores a little health and a lot of resolve.

name: Field Poultice
desc: Moss, fat, and a prayer. Works far better than it has any right to.

name: Physician's Draught
desc: Tastes like a coin left in a pond. Closes wounds you would rather not look at.

name: Bottled Nap
desc: Twenty minutes of good sleep in a jar. Restores spell points and mild optimism.

name: Philosopher's Espresso
desc: Restores a great deal of psyche. You will not blink for an hour.

name: Bitter Root
desc: Chew it before a fight. Raises strength for the battle and ruins your evening.

name: Suspicious Pollen
desc: Raises dexterity for the battle. Also, briefly, your opinion of shrubs.

name: Suspicious Egg
desc: Warm. Occasionally. Nobody at the market wants to discuss it.

name: Damp Wool
desc: It will never fully dry. It has decided.

name: Greasy Haunch
desc: Meat of indeterminate provenance. Sells well in a bad year.

name: Stolen Trinket
desc: Somebody's. Formerly.

name: Chewed Boot
desc: One boot. Extensively chewed. Still, a boot.

name: Crumpled Writ
desc: An official demand for money, addressed to nobody in particular.

name: Salvaged Steel
desc: Enough good metal to be worth carrying, and a maker's mark nobody wants traced back to them.

name: Rank Pelt
desc: Warm, durable, and impossible to sit downwind of.

name: Venom Sac
desc: Handle it the way you would handle a live grudge.

name: Bog Gland
desc: Alchemists pay for these and refuse to say why.

name: Chitin Scrap
desc: Light, strong, and faintly ticking.

name: Scaled Hide
desc: Armourers get a look in their eye about this.

name: Wrong Meat
desc: It is meat. It is wrong. Both are load-bearing.

name: Moon-Bleached Feather
desc: Weighs nothing. Casts a shadow anyway.

name: Troll Fat
desc: Renders into an ointment nobody admits to buying.

name: Someone's Locket
desc: The portrait inside has been scratched out with great care.

name: Grave Wrappings
desc: Astonishingly good linen. Astonishingly bad provenance.

name: Enormous Eye
desc: It tracks you across the room. In the bag. Through the bag.

name: Shard of Old Ice
desc: Has not melted. Will not melt. Is getting colder.

name: Cracked Crystal
desc: Hums a fifth below anything you sing at it.

name: Brass Fragment
desc: Engraved with clause nine of something.

name: Ancient Shell
desc: Older than the kingdom. Considerably better preserved.

name: Waterlogged Purse
desc: The coins inside have fused into one large coin.

name: Ash Residue
desc: Was a person. Is now a reagent. The market moved on quickly.

name: Femur, Unclaimed
desc: Sturdy. Faintly indignant.

name: Cold Residue
desc: Condensed regret. Keeps drinks chilled.

name: Porcelain Shard
desc: Part of a smile. Still smiling.

name: Ember of Sleep
desc: Burns cold. Smells like the room you grew up in.

name: Infernal Sigil
desc: A middle manager's seal, from a very large organisation.

name: Dragon Scale
desc: Worth more than the house you were born in.

name: Hoard Coin
desc: Minted by a kingdom that no longer exists, and still worth more than yours.

name: Smelling Salts, Militant
desc: Brings a person round by making unconsciousness the worse option.

name: Still-Warm Heart
desc: Somebody's. It keeps beating, which is the useful part.
